flags.why: The word means following someone or something with one's eyes or attention, whereas 'watch over' implies protective supervision ([VDict](https://vdict.com/d%C3%B5i%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: to follow with one's eyes; to watch attentively

flags.why: This sense belongs to formal discussion, especially business and policy, rather than ordinary casual speech.

The entry omits the common Southern meaning referring to the soft-fleshed dessert melon called dưa bở in the North ([Ngôn ngữ & Đời sống](https://vci.vnu.edu.vn/upload/15022/pdf/5763a3387f8b9af0d88b45b0.pdf)).
flags.fix: noun [Southern] | a melon with soft, crumbly flesh when ripe, commonly eaten with sugar

flags.why: The gloss incorrectly restricts the flesh to greenish, although common dưa lưới varieties also have yellow or orange flesh ([grower's description](https://dualuoi.vn/blog/dua-luoi-vang/)).
flags.fix: netted melon (a sweet melon with a net-patterned rind)
